column1: # The v0.13.0 release notes' ERROR claims: the cells whose answer is a refusal. One per line:
# Tab-separated, `#` comments ignored. Each program must exit NON-ZERO and its stderr must
# contain the substring. Each program is ONE line.
# --- "A view is data — `{tag, props, children}` records and text nodes": anything else is
# --- refused by name, not rendered as something.
a view node must be an element record
# --- "`dev_generation()` tells a program which start it is": it takes no arguments.
# --- Fixed: "a tag or attribute name must be a plain name"; "`<script>` … refused".
cannot be part of a view
